## nf-core-fetchngs-local-20261008-uuid: nf-core/fetchngs 955c892, post-fix qualification limit
native: prior successful reference recorded above; no new run
iunctus: UUID support fixed by e2105457; pipeline rerun not run under the user's new download limit
verdict: full output parity remains unqualified; the last measured pipeline result predates the UUID fix
notes: java.util.UUID.randomUUID now uses the locked uuid 1.26.1 v4 OS random source. UUID.fromString, lower-case toString, Java equality/hash and class identity are implemented. uuids_are_random checks format, version/variant bits and 64 distinct identifiers; uuid_parses_values checks parsing, equality, identity, map/set keys and Java exceptions against the bundled Groovy oracle. Both regressions failed before the fix and passed after it; all 200 non-ignored evaluator tests, Clippy, formatting and style passed. Cargo.lock adds only the evaluator's uuid dependency. The release build passed with CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0.
